data.name: Asbat
data.gender_notes: Asbat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'asbaah', meaning 'young horse'. This name is a nod to the strength, power, and agility of this majestic creature. The name Asbat carries the meaning “Young Horse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asbat usually hope their child will grow to embody young horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards spiritual growth and self-mastery, as a horse represents the ability to conquer one's own inner struggles and overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Asbat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asbat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
